faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Microneedling with Ginkgo Biloba

items.q: Does Microneedling with Ginkgo Biloba hurt?
items.a: The sensation can vary from person to person. It is generally described as tolerable, and the protocol can be adapted according to the professional assessment and individual sensitivity.

items.q: Does it help with facial glow?
items.a: Many people choose this treatment as part of skincare protocols designed to support facial radiance and revitalization.
The number of sessions depends on your skin and individual goals. That's why we recommend a personalized assessment.
Results are generally progressive and can vary depending on your skin and post-treatment care.
Temporary sensitivity may occur after the procedure. You will receive specific post-treatment care recommendations.

items.q: Can it be combined with other facial treatments?
items.a: Yes, depending on your professional assessment and the recommended protocol.

items.q: What should I do after the treatment?
items.a: Sun protection, hydration, and following the aftercare recommendations provided by the center are important.

items.q: Can it help with the appearance of uneven skin texture?
items.a: Many people incorporate this treatment into skincare protocols designed to improve the overall appearance of skin texture and radiance.
